datesInvalid: Pick a start and end date
apiBy: Same check as POST /api/listing-check. Runs on assumed rates — no PayPal or AI call.
sheetKicker: DisputeLess API · quick check before you publish
anS: Checking the product details you entered against your sale period ({{period}}).
anSteps: Applying assumed dispute rates by type
probL: Chance of a dispute per order
dotsL: {{n}} units · each dot is one sale
lossTip: For each likely dispute we assume you refund {{refundShare}} of the time (you lose the price) and contest the rest (if you lose: the price plus the {{fee}} PayPal dispute fee). Each dispute also costs {{time}} of your time. We play this out over {{runs}} simulated sale periods and take the average. Rates are planning assumptions, not your PayPal history.
